title: Wall Mount Paper Towel Holder 15.5-Inch Iron Pipeline Collection | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Paper Towel Holder 15.5-Inch | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade countertop space with a wall mount paper towel holder built for everyday kitchen use. Part of the Pipeline collection, it brings an industrial pipe-inspired look that suits transitional spaces.

Highlights:
- Wall-mounted installation helps keep paper towels accessible while saving counter space
- Iron construction with a highly durable powder coat for a clean, decorative finish
- Industrial styling that blends with modern and traditional decor
- Color-coordinated mounting hardware included for a consistent look
- Limited lifetime warranty

Specs:
- Collection: Pipeline
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Material: Iron
- Overall size: 15.5 in L x 4 in W x 3 in H (projection: 4 in)
- Weight: 1.3 lb
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
- Included: Paper towel holder and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Finish options: available in multiple designer finish options
